ConfirmDelete: 您确认要删除用户 {name} 吗？
OtpHint: An authenticator app adds an additional layer of security to your account by requiring one time codes generated by the app to log in.
OtpSetupHint: 使用您的验证器应用扫描二维码或复制下方的的密钥
AllowPasswordlessLoginHint: With this enabled your Passkeys allow you to log in without your password or authenticator codes. With this disabled your Passkeys act as a second factor on top of your password, similar to authenticator codes.
RecoveryCodesHint: These codes can be used in place of authenticator codes in case you loose access to those. Each code is valid for exactly one use. They will not be shown again, make sure to keep them in a safe place.
RegenerateRecoveryCodesHint: Regenerating your recovery codes will invalidate all current recovery codes.
